title: LocalLoop skills registry entry (looper#71)
description: Frontmatter of one .SEED/skills/<archetype>/<name>.md file. Documentation and routing only: an entry grants no access.

name.description: kebab-case slug, equal to the file name without .md

form.description: function = code you call; skill = SKILL.md for coding agents; plugin = bundle of skills/commands; mcp = MCP server or tool

archetype.description: Equal to the folder the file sits in. Six map archetypes (localloop.pro-main assets/js/category-taxonomy.js labels) plus media and platform

home_repo.description: The one repo that owns the code or SKILL.md

path.description: Repo-relative path in home_repo (file or folder), no leading slash, no '..'

status.description: candidate = scouted, not agreed; approved = owner OK on an issue; built = exists in home_repo; shared = built and used by more than one repo

owner_floor.description: Floor (team) that maintains it, kebab-case. Naming is an open owner question (GRILL-ME.md Q6); until answered use the home repo name

risk.description: high = writes data, sends messages, spends money, calls an LLM on a platform key, or touches a hot zone

why.description: One line: what repeats or is done by hand that this entry captures
